case_title.reason: Case title matches the judgment header (JODHAN v. STATE OF M.P.).

number_of_accused.reason: Only the appellant appealed; the other accused did not, so one liability is decided.

accused_gender.reason: Appellant is referred to with 'he' and 'his' throughout.

accused_age.reason: No age of the accused is stated.

accused_religion.reason: No religious identity of the accused is stated.

accused_caste.reason: No caste or community of the accused is named.

accused_occupation.reason: No occupation of the accused is stated.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: No statement on wealth, poverty or class is made.

previous_criminal_record.reason: Judgment mentions pending cases only in trial-court reasoning, not a criminal record of the accused.

victim_gender.reason: Deceased (Siria alias Shriram) is referred to as male, with 'him' and 'his'.

victim_caste.reason: Victim's caste or community is not named.

accused_victim_relationship.reason: Inimical terms over non-voting is described at page 18; supported.

offence_category.reason: Offence is murder under s.302 read with s.149 IPC.

statutory_provisions.reason: Charges under ss.302, 323, 324, 149, 148 IPC and Explosive Substances Act ss.3, 4 match page 7 and 8.

weapon.correct_value: Lathis, farsa and handmade bombs (explosive); deceased killed by a handmade bomb thrown on his chest
weapon.quote: armed with lathis, farsa and handmade bombs
weapon.reason: Weapons are right, but 'axe-like weapon' describing the farsa is not in the judgment.

evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness, medical, recovery and FIR evidence are all relied on in the judgment.

confession.reason: No confession or admission by the accused is mentioned.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: Armed aggressors, pre-determined bomb throw and injured witnesses are all noted at pages 16 and 26-27.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: No mitigating circumstances are noted in the judgment.

trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court acquitted all accused after disbelieving the prosecution, as stated at page 9.

high_court_outcome.reason: High Court reversed acquittal and imposed life imprisonment under s.302 r/w s.149, sentences concurrent (page 7).

offence_finally_established.reason: Murder under s.302 r/w s.149 IPC is the finally upheld offence.

imprisonment_type.reason: Rigorous imprisonment for life was imposed by the High Court and upheld.

imprisonment_years.reason: Life sentence is not a fixed term, so null is right.

fine_rs.reason: No fine is mentioned in the judgment.

neutral_facts.reason: Summary covers the incident, injuries, post-mortem, FIR and seizures without names or court outcomes.

offence_severity.reason: The judgment does not state the statutory punishment range for s.302.

attempt_completion.reason: Death of the deceased makes the offence completed.

physical_harm.reason: Death from bomb injury and witnesses' blast and incised injuries are described at pages 15-16.

number_of_offences.reason: Six charged sections (including Explosive Substances Act) and one finally upheld, consistent with pages 7 and 27.

financial_property_loss.reason: No money or property loss is discussed.

premeditation_planning.quote: with pre-determined mind threw the bomb on the chest of the deceased
premeditation_planning.reason: Court accepted the pre-determined mind when the bomb was thrown.

motive.reason: Objection to abuses as trigger is accepted; non-voting enmity noted but not a ground to discard witnesses (page 18).

key_evidence_accepted.reason: Injured eye witnesses PW-7, 14, 15, 16, autopsy of PW-13, injury and MLC reports, and FIR are relied on.

witness_credibility.reason: Injured related witnesses found reliable, consistent, and supported by medical evidence and FIR.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Accused led police to the place of recovery, and the lathis, farsa and handmade bombs were seized on their being led by the accused persons
post_offence_conduct.quote: on being led by the accused persons seized the weapons, namely, lathi, farsa and handmade bombs
post_offence_conduct.reason: Judgment records that the accused led police to the weapons, so 'Not stated' is wrong.

custody_duration.reason: Appellant's custody period is not stated.

trial_duration.reason: Offence date 7.1.1984, High Court 12.12.2005 and Supreme Court 8.4.2015 are given; trial judgment date is not given.

legal_representation.reason: Counsel for appellant and State match page 7.

investigation_status.reason: FIR, spot map, seizures, chemical examination, chargesheet, committal and trial are described at pages 8-9.

procedural_irregularity.reason: No procedural lapse is noted by the court.

appeal_history.reason: Trial acquittal, High Court conviction and Supreme Court dismissal of appeal are accurately recorded.

prosecution_argument.reason: State's submissions on perversity, minor discrepancies, reliable witnesses and s.149 liability match page 10-11.

defence_argument.reason: Appellant's submissions on perversity, interested witnesses, non-examination and no overt act match pages 10-11.

legal_principle_applied.reason: Plausible-view and perversity tests, injured witness reliability and s.149 vicarious liability are applied.
